title: Postcard and Summer
author: Odile Voss
blurb: Zephyrine Oyelaran, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
